## Load libraries
```{r}
library(renv)           # save package versions
library(tidyverse)      # data managing
library(tidyr)          # data handling
library(dplyr)          # data managing
library(ggplot2)        # plotting
library(lme4)           # mixed (logistic) models
library(emmeans)
library(glue)
library(stringr)
```

## Import data
```{r}
subject_id <- 47
subject_id <- str_pad(subject_id, 3, pad = "0")

combined_dataframe_location <- glue("/Volumes/project/3025011.02/raw/sub-{subject_id}/ses-mri01/beh")
combined_dataframe_name <- glue("behavioural_output_sub-{subject_id}_session-01_")

df <- read.csv(dir(combined_dataframe_location, full.names=T, pattern=combined_dataframe_name), header = TRUE, sep = ";")
```

## Filter the data a bit
```{r}
df <- df[df$probability_condition != 50, ]
df <- df[df$objectively_correct != 'Late', ]
```

## Redefine as factors
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    response = case_when(
      response == "up" ~ 1,
      response == "down" ~ -1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_  # for any other values
    ),
    subjectively_correct = case_when(
      subjectively_correct == "True" ~ 1,
      subjectively_correct == "False" ~ -1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

df$response_1_back <- c(df$response[-1], NA)
df$response_2_back <- c(df$response[-(1:2)], NA, NA)
df$subjectively_correct_1_back <- c(df$subjectively_correct[-1], NA)
df$subjectively_correct_2_back <- c(df$subjectively_correct[-(1:2)], NA, NA)

df$response <- as.factor(df$response)
df$response_1_back <- as.factor(df$response_1_back)
df$response_2_back <- as.factor(df$response_2_back)

df$subjectively_correct <- as.factor(df$subjectively_correct)
df$subjectively_correct_1_back <- as.factor(df$subjectively_correct_1_back)
df$subjectively_correct_2_back <- as.factor(df$subjectively_correct_2_back)
```

## Run model for angry stimuli
```{r}
model <- glm(response ~ response_1_back * subjectively_correct_1_back + response_2_back * subjectively_correct_2_back,
              data = df_stimuli_1 <- df[df$stimuli_type == 1, ],
              family = binomial())

# See if they learned
summary(model)
```

## Run model for happy stimuli
```{r}
model <- glm(response ~ response_1_back * subjectively_correct_1_back + response_2_back * subjectively_correct_2_back,
              data = df_stimuli_2 <- df[df$stimuli_type == 2, ],
              family = binomial())

# See if they learned
summary(model)
```
